strings.드디어 마지막 방이에요! 색깔의 방에서 받은 1과 6, 소리와 지도에서: This is the last room at last! The 1 and the 6 from the Color room, the 1 and the 8 from Sound and Map. All four secret cards are here together.
strings.카드에 적힌 숫자를 차례로 눌러 마지막 문을 열어 봐요!: Tap the numbers on the cards in order and open the last door!
strings.카드 네 장이 모두 모였어요! 색깔, 소리, 지도 순서대로 카드에 적힌: All four cards are here! Tap the numbers on them in order — Color, Sound, Map — to open the last door.
strings.🔐 마지막 문 — 카드의 숫자를 차례로: 🔐 The last door — the card numbers, in order
strings.황금비 1.618은 그냥 한 개의 수가 아니라 1 대 1.618이라는 비: The golden ratio 1.618 is not just one number — it is the ratio 1 to 1.618. If you call the base length 1, the golden length is 1.618 times as long. Move the bar below to change the base. What happens to the golden bar when the base gets longer?
strings.📏 기준을 여러 번 바꿔 가며 두 막대를 견주어 봐요: 📏 Change the base a few times and compare the two bars
strings.1.618, 황금비는 예로부터 아름답다고 여겨진 비예요. 수학에서는 세: The golden ratio, 1.618, has been called beautiful for a very long time. Three examples stand out in mathematics. In a golden rectangle the long side is 1.618 times the short one, and if you cut a square off it, what is left is the same shape again. In a regular pentagon, the diagonal divided by a side is exactly 1.618. And in the Fibonacci numbers, where each number is the sum of the two before it, the ratio of neighbours creeps closer and closer to 1.618. Just as you found in color, sound and maps, the Secret of Ratio is hidden all over the world. Thank you so much for coming all this way with me!
strings.🎉 여정 완주 — 비 감각의 달인!: 🎉 Journey complete — you have a real sense for ratio!
strings.여러분은 지금까지 색깔과 소리, 리듬, 지도, 지구의 비밀을 확인하고 황: So far you have uncovered the secrets of color, sound, rhythm, maps and the Earth, and you found the golden ratio too. So what is the Secret of Ratio? It is this: a ratio is always hiding somewhere around us. Now that you know it, keep looking around, find the ratios, and discover many more things!
strings.🔎 다섯 방의 비를 한자리에 — 비의 비밀: 🔎 Every ratio in one place — the Secret of Ratio
strings.가로가 세로의 1.618배인 직사각형. 정사각형을 떼어내도 남은 직사각형: A rectangle whose long side is 1.618 times its short side. Cut a square off it and the rectangle left over is 1 : 1.618 again.
strings.정오각형은 대각선을 한 변으로 나누면 꼭 1.618이 나와요. 어림이 아: Divide a diagonal of a regular pentagon by one of its sides and you get exactly 1.618 — not close to it, exactly the golden ratio.
strings.앞의 두 수를 더해 만든 수열이에요. 이웃한 두 수의 비가 점점 1.61: Each number is the sum of the two before it. The ratio of two neighbours gets closer and closer to 1.618.
strings.카드의 숫자를 이으니 황금비 φ가 되었어요! 문이 열립니다!: Line up the card numbers and you get the golden ratio φ! The door opens!
strings.1.618, 황금비를 찾았어요! 문이 열립니다!: 1.618 — you found the golden ratio! The door opens!
strings.네 장의 카드에 적힌 숫자를 왼쪽부터 차례로 읽어 볼까요?: Shall we read the four card numbers from left to right?
strings.색깔의 방에서 받은 두 장이 먼저예요. 카드 아래 숫자를 왼쪽부터 그대로: The two cards from the Color room come first. Tap the numbers under the cards from the left, just as they are.
strings.카드의 숫자를 그대로 이어 붙이면 네 자리 수가 돼요 — 다시 한 번!: Line the card numbers up just as they are and you get a four-digit number — try again!
